Container.Name: ProtonVPN
Container.Overview:
Official Proton VPN CLI with a WebUI and shared VPN network. Proton does not officially support headless use. Open WebUI to sign in (including TOTP) and configure settings, or use the Console button for interactive protonvpn commands. FIDO2 is console-only and unverified. Set a WebUI password: leaving it empty enables open access, even if API_KEY is set.
Attach other containers with --network=container:ProtonVPN and publish their application ports on this VPN container. Set LAN_NETWORKS to your trusted LAN CIDRs for direct application access. Drop NET_RAW from attached containers (--cap-drop=NET_RAW), never grant them NET_ADMIN, and start them only after this container is healthy. The kill switch prevents accidental leaks, not hostile code. If this VPN container is recreated, recreate attached containers to join its new network namespace.
The forwarded port is shown in the WebUI and /config/forwarded_port; configure your torrent listener to match it. The supervisor handles reconnects; Docker health status alone does not trigger restarts. Requires cgroup v2, xt_cgroup, WireGuard kernel support and /dev/net/tun. This project is not affiliated with Proton AG.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: WebUI and API TCP port. If WEBUI_PORT is changed, also change this container port to match.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: Persistent Proton session tokens, settings, CLI logs and forwarded_port. Protect this directory and backups as sensitive data.

Config.Name: WebUI password
Config.Description: Optional WebUI password, not your Proton password. Empty enables open WebUI/API access with a warning; API_KEY alone does not secure open mode.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional separate bearer credential for scripts and for Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics scraping of /metrics, which needs it whenever WEBUI_PASSWORD is set. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Also set WEBUI_PASSWORD: an API key does not secure open mode.

Config.Name: LAN networks
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs allowed outside the tunnel, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Needed for direct LAN access to attached application ports. Empty allows no additional LAN networks.

Config.Name: Server
Config.Description: Exact server name, e.g. NL#914. Non-empty overrides COUNTRY/CITY and locks this WebUI field. Empty uses saved settings or automatic selection.

Config.Name: Country
Config.Description: Country code or full name. Ignored when SERVER is set. Non-empty locks this WebUI field; empty uses saved settings or automatic selection.

Config.Name: City
Config.Description: City filter. Ignored when SERVER is set. Non-empty locks this WebUI field; empty uses saved settings or automatic selection.

Config.Name: P2P
Config.Description: Request P2P servers. Empty uses saved settings; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: true, false.

Config.Name: Secure Core
Config.Description: Request Secure Core servers. Empty uses saved settings; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: true, false.

Config.Name: Tor
Config.Description: Request Tor servers. Empty uses saved settings; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: true, false.

Config.Name: NetShield
Config.Description: NetShield protection level. Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: off, malware-only, malware-ads-trackers.

Config.Name: Port forwarding
Config.Description: NAT-PMP port forwarding; requires an eligible plan/server. Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Port appears in WebUI and /config/forwarded_port. Values: off, on.

Config.Name: VPN Accelerator
Config.Description: VPN Accelerator. Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: off, on.

Config.Name: Moderate NAT
Config.Description: Moderate NAT. Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: off, on.

Config.Name: IPv6
Config.Description: IPv6 VPN setting. Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: off, on.

Config.Name: Custom DNS
Config.Description: off, or on --dns 1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8 (comma-separated IPv4/IPv6 addresses). Empty uses saved settings then CLI default; non-empty locks this WebUI field.

Config.Name: Anonymous crash reports
Config.Description: Anonymous CLI crash reports. Empty uses saved settings then Python startup default off, leaving WebUI editable. Non-empty locks this WebUI field. Values: off, on.

Config.Name: Internal WebUI port
Config.Description: Internal WebUI/API listen port, decimal 1-65535 without leading zeros. Invalid values stop startup. Update the container port mapping if changed; attached applications must use different listen ports.

Config.Name: WebUI allowed networks
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs or addresses allowed to reach the WebUI and API port, as the container sees the source address. Empty allows any non-VPN source. Loopback needs 127.0.0.1/32 listed. Proton tunnel connections to this HTTP port are always blocked. Invalid values stop startup. Recreate the container to change.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

Config.Name: Debug logging
Config.Description: Enable verbose CLI and NetworkManager logging with true. Empty uses the image default false. Review logs before sharing. Values: false, true.

Config.Name: Reconnect interval
Config.Description: Supervisor connection-check interval in seconds, at least 1. Default 30. Docker health status does not itself restart the container.
